verdict.rationale: cubic documents `cubic.yaml` at the repository root as the source of truth for AI review behavior, ignore patterns (path filters), PR descriptions and custom agents. That covers a versioned in-repo config with path filtering and custom review rules, and a community comment independently confirms the YAML-in-repo approach. Missing for 10: explicit per-path instruction scoping, named review profiles/presets, and detailed schema documentation in the evidence.
